dispositions.publicPosture: Global notification delivery lifecycle is shipped; tenant-selected channel configuration is not.
dispositions.runtimePosture: Notification channels remain deployment-configured and are not tenant-selectable.
dispositions.tenantScope: No tenant may select or mutate its own notification-channel set.
promotionRequirements: Tenant-owned channel configuration, route authorization, isolation, and integration evidence.

dispositions.publicPosture: Approver identity provenance is recorded, but HIL transitions do not carry approver WebAuthn signatures.
dispositions.runtimePosture: Transition events use current authenticated provenance and issuer custody without a passkey signature.
dispositions.tenantScope: No tenant receives a cryptographic approver-signature claim over a transition.
promotionRequirements: Versioned transition-signature envelope, verified credential binding, chain commitment, and tenant-isolation evidence.

dispositions.publicPosture: OIDC and role authorization are shipped; per-decision and agent-lifecycle WebAuthn step-up is not.
dispositions.runtimePosture: High-impact decide and lifecycle routes do not require a new WebAuthn ceremony.
dispositions.tenantScope: No tenant may rely on per-operation passkey step-up as an authorization boundary.
promotionRequirements: Typed operation challenge, fresh ceremony enforcement, replay protection, tenant binding, and live negative evidence.

dispositions.publicPosture: Single-replica policy durability is shipped; multi-replica compiled-rule consistency is not.
dispositions.runtimePosture: The supported policy-engine posture remains one replica without a replicated rule-set agreement protocol.
dispositions.tenantScope: No tenant receives a multi-replica policy consistency or availability guarantee.
promotionRequirements: Authoritative replicated state, ordered activation, fail-closed readiness, partition tests, and tenant-isolated convergence evidence.

dispositions.publicPosture: CLI policy test, learn, scaffold, library, and exchange workflows are shipped; exact CRUD parity is not.
dispositions.runtimePosture: Policy create, read, update, activate, deactivate, and delete are not exposed as one complete CLI surface.
dispositions.tenantScope: No tenant receives a claim that the CLI covers the full policy administration API.
promotionRequirements: Complete typed CLI CRUD commands, device-authorized tenant confinement, audit evidence, and parity tests.

dispositions.publicPosture: The 25-case hermetic mock corpus is shipped; a pinned real-provider accuracy result is not published.
dispositions.runtimePosture: CI remains deterministic and does not call a paid external model to produce an accuracy claim.
dispositions.tenantScope: No tenant or provider workload is represented by a published real-provider accuracy claim.
promotionRequirements: Pinned provider and model, reviewed dataset, reproducible operator run, cost receipt, and published accuracy methodology.

dispositions.publicPosture: Sandbox severity is a reviewed static annotation over the pinned corpus, not execution isolation or authorization.
dispositions.runtimePosture: The pure analyzer deterministically classifies 40 reviewed filesystem, shell, HTTP, SQL, malformed, and unknown cases.
dispositions.tenantScope: Analysis is tenant-agnostic and carries no authority; callers enforce tenant identity and authorization outside the analyzer.

dispositions.publicPosture: Biometric mobile-push approval is not a shipped Clavenar channel.
dispositions.runtimePosture: No mobile push provider, device enrollment, biometric assertion, or mobile callback route is enabled.
dispositions.tenantScope: No tenant may configure or rely on biometric mobile-push approval.
promotionRequirements: Provider integration, tenant device enrollment, signed callback binding, revocation, replay defense, and live evidence.

dispositions.publicPosture: Quorum and advisory escalation are shipped; named approver-group authorization is not.
dispositions.runtimePosture: Eligible approvers may satisfy quorum without a pending-specific named-group authorization gate.
dispositions.tenantScope: No tenant may rely on a pending being decidable only by one configured approver group.
promotionRequirements: Tenant-owned group membership, pending-to-group binding, deny-unknown authorization, lifecycle handling, and live negative evidence.
